data.text: Added lib/background.ts with keepAlive() wrapper. Applied to routes: app/api/live/session, phone, webhook; app/api/agents/launch, dev/simulate, events. Prevents Vercel from freezing function after response sent, allowing negotiation loops to run to completion.
data.rationale: Vercel freezes a function once its response is sent. The call loops therefore need after() and a long maxDuration to keep running.

data.text: Calling strategy: Twilio initiates outbound call to team member; OpenAI Live API bridges the SIP connection; strategist agent drives conversation via GPT-Live. Does not require OpenAI account outbound SIP enablement.
data.rationale: Avoids OpenAI account enablement requirement; leverages existing Twilio infrastructure and web hook acceptance

evidence: The route that works today: Twilio dials the team member's phone and connects the call to GPT-Live. OpenAI then pings our webhook on Vercel, we accept the call, and our strategist drives the conversation. It doesn't need OpenAI to enable outbound calling for your account.
